Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class HybridWell

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.HybridWell
public final class HybridWell extends Object
Production well of the hybrid production model: reservoir-state proxy, inflow performance, tubing lift curve and choke.

The well rate is not read from a production profile. For a given pressure at the network node the well is tied to, solveOperatingPoint(double) finds the oil rate where the flowing bottom-hole pressure offered by the reservoir (inflow performance at the current reservoir pressure and productivity index) equals the pressure the tubing needs to lift that rate to the node (lift curve at the current water cut and gas-oil ratio). A rate target or a choke restricts the well below that potential. Reservoir pressure, productivity index, water cut and gas-oil ratio come from ReservoirStateModel proxies that follow the cumulative volumes, so the operating point moves both with depletion and with the network back-pressure.

Basis: rates are stock-tank oil in Sm3/day, the productivity index is Sm3 oil/(day bar), water cut is the water fraction of the liquid and the gas-oil ratio is Sm3/Sm3. The tubing lift model must use the same basis (see VfpTableLookup.onOilBasis()).

  • Constructor Details

    • HybridWell

      public HybridWell(String name, ReservoirStateModel state, VlpProvider tubing)
      Creates a well.
      Parameters:
      name - well name
      state - reservoir-state proxy following the well's own cumulative volumes; supplies water cut, gas-oil ratio and productivity index, and the reservoir pressure unless a drainage unit is set
      tubing - tubing lift model on the oil rate, water cut and gas-oil ratio basis, giving the flowing bottom-hole pressure at the well datum for a wellhead pressure
